facts.fact: The NDPC issued a 21-day compliance notice to 1,369 organisations (795 financial institutions, 392 insurance brokers, 35 insurers, 10 pension firms, 136 gaming operators) in a sector-wide investigation under the NDPA 2023, with no decision reported.
The document states the NDPC recently imposed a N766.2 million fine on Multichoice Nigeria, the largest single penalty so far; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.
The NDPC acts through its Head of Legal, Enforcement and Regulations, Babatunde Bamigboye, who issued the statement.
The NDPC enforces the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023, against named sectors, treating it as in force.
